facts.fact: Micah 在诊所处理躁动的幼狮鹫。
facts.anchor: If this griffin fledgling bites me one more time

facts.fact: 伤因是爪垫里的 fyreberry 刺。
facts.anchor: Just as I suspected, the culprit is a fyreberry thorn buried deep in the soft pad beneath its talon.

facts.fact: Micah 暗恋街对面的铁匠 Lucan，二人尚未交谈。
facts.anchor: We’ve never actually spoken, but I’ve admired him from afar

facts.fact: 学徒 Elowen 回诊所并打趣 Micah 偷看铁匠。
facts.anchor: Elowen strolls in from their lunch break

facts.fact: Micah 下班后走向山脚的住处。
facts.anchor: My cottage sits at the foot of Mount Embercrest

facts.fact: Micah 在林路发现红色蛋壳。
facts.anchor: Frowning, I glance down to see a shard of crimson eggshell beneath my boot.

facts.fact: 被发现的幼龙翼膜发育不全。
facts.anchor: The membranes never fully formed, leaving behind two undersized, misshapen limbs

facts.fact: Micah 用斗篷裹住幼龙，把它带往住处。
facts.anchor: I unfasten my cloak and carefully wrap the hatchling inside the thick wool.
